schema_provenance.rc_rule: source_commit identifies an ancestor structural checkpoint whose manifest and structural fingerprint are equivalent to this technical RC content. The schema-consolidation workflow proves the executable DDL on the current commit; the v5.00-rc.1 path recomputes the same evidence on the exact tag. A later structural change requires a new RC checkpoint.

technical_rc.cut_rule: This commit content is eligible to become the immutable technical RC only after engineering CI for the exact commit is green. The external act of creating the tag/pre-release does not rewrite RELEASE_INFO.txt, does not publish a normative release and does not close external gates.

notes: This manifest describes candidate state only and does not publish or seal a release.
RELEASE_INFO.txt remains the authoritative metadata for the last sealed release.
The candidate binds an ancestor structural checkpoint and schema hashes; .NET SourceRevisionId continues to identify each binary build.
technical_rc.status describes intrinsic checkpoint content; the existence of the immutable tag/pre-release records the external cut event after exact-commit CI is green.
Microsoft SQL Server is the operational relational target for Production; Fabric SQL evidence is historical compatibility evidence and is not a release gate for this candidate.
